summary: Inland Real Estate Income Trust filed an Item 8.01 current report announcing a routine quarterly common-stock distribution of $0.135600 per share to holders of record as of September 30, 2026, payable on or about October 7, 2026, in cash or via the company's distribution reinvestment plan. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, strategic review, or management change is disclosed; the filing is an ordinary dividend declaration by the non-traded REIT. No board advisor, premium, stake, or regulatory clock applies. Watch only for consistency of the distribution rate and DRIP participation.
